description: Reads one order you prepared with prepare_checkout, under the same grant. The answer carries `state`: approval_required (the person has not approved it yet), payment_pending (the person approved it; paying and following the order is theirs, on Escrova), not_started (it expired, was cancelled or is not yours; nothing is waiting) or reconciliation_required (this read was refused or failed, so it says nothing about the order, which may still be waiting: read the body, fix the request and read again). It stays payment_pending after they pay, because this tool cannot see the payment and never reports a finished purchase: ask the person. Bind the challenge to GET /api/agent/checkout-intents/<intentId>, the id in the path and no body.

delegationGrantId.description: The grant the order was prepared under.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.
